content_sections.heading: MGU Kottayam High School Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the MGU Kottayam recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Mahatma Gandhi University recruitment is High School Assistant. This is a contractual position with a single vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the High School Assistant post at MGU Kottayam is scheduled for 29th September 2026. Candidates should report at the specified time on this date.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the High School Assistant post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the High School Assistant position, candidates must possess a Degree and a B.Lisc or M.Lisc from any recognized University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the High School Assistant post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government/university rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the High School Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the High School Assistant post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 17,500/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the High School Assistant post?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview at the MGU Kottayam office with all necessary original documents and self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the High School Assistant post at MGU Kottayam will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Mahatma Gandhi University located?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University is located in Kottayam, Kerala, with the pincode 686560.
